lines.trans: I have a lot of work right now.
You must also think of yourself.
I have fifteen actors to manage now.
Is this paternity business bothering you?
I am still thinking about it, Mom.
Mathias is coming far too late for that.
You wanted him to acknowledge me once.
Yes, when we needed him!
He is making a nice gesture today.
It is easy after twenty-seven years of absence.
I am not going to change my name.
Thankfully! I did everything all alone.
I understand your anger, you are right.
Take care of yourself above all, honey.
